content:
A failed grind will automatically report its state. Is there a trace that will have grind report its final state when it succeeds?

EDIT: you can use set_option trace.grind.assert true to see how the state changes. trace.grind.eqc, trace.grind.ematch.instance, and the other engine-specific traces will tell you which engine generated the fact logged by trace.grind.assert. Is there a trace for the final True/False sets and all the equivalence classes?
